# Beast Mastery

Test fixture guide, not a real leveling guide. Its guide-build digits
(1/1/1) are deliberately different from marksmanship.md's (5/5/5) so
TestRunSpecPublishesDifferentSetDPSForDifferentTalentStrings
(main_test.go) drives two specs whose LadderTalentString output
actually differs at the same band.
